channels.name: Canadian Political Attention Cycle
channels.description: Most-read likelihood scores high for Canada-centred leadership or national-politics stories and low for otherwise comparable foreign-government coverage.
channels.parent: Canadian audience concentration and story-volume bursts

channels.name: Trump-Election Media Cohort
channels.description: Scores high for stories embedded in the Trump-era US election, White House, and partisan-media ecosystem and low for politics outside that event cohort.
channels.parent: capture-period concentration around US election cycles

channels.name: Pandemic Variant Cohort
channels.description: Scores high for headlines about newly identified or spreading disease variants and low for routine public-health coverage.

channels.name: Russia-Wagner Crisis Burst
channels.description: Scores high for Putin–Wagner power struggles or sudden Russian leadership ruptures and low for routine diplomacy or chronic conflict coverage.
channels.parent: short-lived event burst in the capture period

channels.name: Royal-Over-Government Britain Split
channels.description: Scores high for British royal-household personalities and disputes but low for UK prime-ministerial or institutional-policy stories.
channels.parent: audience appetite for monarchy over domestic governance

channels.name: Celebrity Intimate-Life Litigation
channels.description: Scores high for actors or entertainers involved in divorce, partner conflict, abuse allegations, or reputation trials and low for their ordinary professional work.

channels.name: Graphic Interpersonal Crime Beat
channels.description: Scores high for explicit sexual violence, stabbing, or killing involving identifiable individuals and low for less graphic crime or justice-policy headlines.
channels.parent: severity-driven crime attention and editorial selection

channels.name: Sudden Transport-Infrastructure Disaster
channels.description: Scores high for abrupt plane, bridge, or falling-related catastrophes and low for gradual transport or infrastructure policy stories.

channels.name: Contemporary Forensic Discovery Beat
channels.description: Scores high for present-day cases involving recovered people or remains, DNA identification, or newly surfaced evidence and low for unresolved searches or abstract forensic policy.
channels.parent: episodic closure in crime and missing-person cases

channels.name: Global-South Hard-News Disadvantage
channels.description: Scores low for headlines centred on African states, India, or displaced ethnic minorities and high for otherwise similar North American-centred coverage.
channels.parent: audience geography and international-edition market fit

channels.name: Leisure-Vertical Discount
channels.description: Scores low for recurring quiz, football, album, or curated-photo-slot content and high for discrete breaking-news events.

channels.name: Prospective Institutional Modality
channels.description: Scores low when a headline foregrounds what an institution can, could, will, or should do and high when it reports a completed concrete event.
channels.parent: policy-analysis genre and newsroom tense conventions

channels.name: Comment-Enabled Discussion Marker
channels.description: Scores high when the headline visibly signals an attached reader-discussion or comments package and low when no participation metadata appears.
